features.name: age_zscore_clipped
features.description: Age centered and scaled with training-fold mean and standard deviation after clipping to observed bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a normalized life-stage axis with reduced influence from extreme ages.

features.name: education_zscore_clipped
features.description: Years of schooling centered and scaled with training-fold mean and standard deviation after clipping to observed bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a strong smooth skill-depth axis with scale comparable to other continuous inputs.

features.name: hours_zscore_clipped
features.description: Weekly work time centered and scaled with training-fold mean and standard deviation after clipping to observed bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures broad labor-supply intensity on a conditioned numeric scale for stable margin fitting.

features.name: post_school_seniority_norm
features.description: Approximate working-life duration after subtracting schooling years and a six-year pre-school period, clipped to a 0-1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth seniority proxy that can model accumulated experience separately from raw age.

features.name: education_hours_interaction_norm
features.description: Product of normalized schooling years and normalized weekly work time.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a bounded multiplicative projection for rows combining high skill depth with high work intensity.

features.name: overtime_intensity
features.description: Excess weekly work effort above forty hours, scaled by maximum observed excess.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates standard and high-intensity work schedules with a bounded continuous severity measure.

features.name: low_hours_intensity
features.description: Shortfall from forty weekly hours, scaled by maximum observed shortfall.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a separate bounded axis for reduced work schedules rather than forcing symmetry with overtime.

features.name: log_capital_gain_norm
features.description: Log-scaled capital gain amount normalized by the observed maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns a highly skewed monetary amount into a smooth bounded signal with less outlier dominance.

features.name: log_capital_loss_norm
features.description: Log-scaled capital loss amount normalized by the observed maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents rare financial loss magnitudes on a bounded scale suitable for a linear margin.

features.name: capital_gain_loss_balance_ratio
features.description: Signed ratio contrasting log-normalized gain and loss magnitudes, stabilized with a small denominator offset.
features.expected_model_benefit: Distinguishes one-sided financial events from balanced or no-event cases through a bounded directional score.

features.name: occupational_status_semantic_score
features.description: Human- or ruleset-assigned 0.0-1.0 score using occupation and work sector category meanings from preprocessing metadata; higher values indicate roles generally associated with specialized, professional, managerial, or capital-intensive work.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses job and sector semantics into an ordered score that can be combined linearly instead of treating arbitrary integer encodings as meaningful distances.

features.name: household_role_semantic_score
features.description: Domain-judged 0.0-1.0 score using marital_status, relationship, age, and hours_per_week; higher values indicate greater likely household earning responsibility and stable adult household role.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a compact social-context axis for margin placement, capturing structure not well represented by raw encoded integers.
